summary: TC Energy Corporation furnished a routine Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 MD&A, interim unaudited financial statements, SOX certifications, and a November 5, 2026 news release; TransCanada PipeLines files as a wholly owned subsidiary relying on continuous-disclosure exemptive relief. No transaction terms are stated. The MD&A references only the previously completed October 1, 2024 spin-off of the Liquids Pipelines business into South Bow Corporation, an historical event rather than a new special situation; nothing new is actionable for an event-driven or risk-arbitrage angle.
